title: Exporters and global value chain participation: firm-level evidence from South Africa
summary: The study examines how global value chain (GVC) trade affects the performance of South African manufacturing exporters, comparing the productivity premium of traders across GVC-related and traditional product categories and testing for learning-by-exporting.
keyFindings: GVC-related trade is associated with a higher productivity premium than traditional trade.
methods: SARS–National Treasury firm-level panel data, 2009–2017; productivity premia compared across product categories, with effects estimated before and after export market entry.
